messages:
incident-bot: Pager: detected elevated 5xx rate (API gateway) and token exchange latency impacting Hosted API + Dedicated pools in ap-northeast-1. Alert threshold breached at 2026-06-12T03:12:25Z. Auto-escalating to on-call.
oncall-alex: Acknowledged. Seeing errors + high p95 from the ap-northeast-1 edge. Starting triage.
sre-jordan: Looking at CloudWatch: STS request latency spiked ~20x, many 504/502 from creds-proxy. Could be upstream IAM/STSpool or NAT egress.
eng-ryan: Also seeing a surge of errors in observability (logs delayed). Might be cloudwatch ingestion throttles causing retry storms.
support-kim: Support queue getting duplicates from customers in APAC, some request IDs: rq_2a7f, rq_2a80. Noting customer-reported 502s for Hosted API.
ops-bot: Traffic routing health check: ap-northeast-1 frontends 12/24 healthy, Dedicated pool apn1-gpu-1 showing 30% 5xx.
sre-jordan: Quick mitigation suggestions: 1) route new traffic to ap-northeast-2 / ap-east-1 via smart-routing; 2) enable temporary token-cache TTL increase to reduce STS calls; 3) scale Dedicated standby pool if capacity available.
oncall-alex: Can we flip routing quickly? Eng-ryan, can you run the routing change and confirm compatibility?
eng-ryan: Initiating route diversion now. Command: ```/tools route-set --from ap-northeast-1 --to ap-northeast-2 --policy degraded --duration 30m``` Will monitor.
sre-jordan: Also applying token cache TTL bump: ```kubectl -n auth set env cred-proxy TOKEN_CACHE_TTL=600``` This reduces STS call rate by letting instances reuse tokens longer.
eng-ryan: Route-set accepted. Traffic shift started, ~40% of requests now hitting ap-northeast-2. Watching error rates.
sre-jordan: Observability note: if CloudWatch ingestion is delayed, our dashboards will lag. Use direct ELB/ALB metrics and edge logs for real-time.
pm-lina: Logging customer impact: listing affected customers with heavy traffic in APAC; marking potential P1 for impacted SLAs. I'll open an incident in PagerDuty with severity P1 and link to customer list.
support-kim: Please add a public status note template. I'll prep comms if customers escalate.
oncall-alex: Handing to SRE Jordan for continued mitigation /pager handoff in 10m. I'll stay in-thread until stable. :thumbsup:
sre-jordan: On it. Next steps: continue route diversion until 95th percentile errors drop below threshold, keep token-cache TTL, request AWS support ticket for STS region egress errors. If AWS confirms degraded STS, we'll schedule a controlled rollback to regional fallbacks.
eng-ryan: Observed p95 latency down ~30% since diversion started, 5xx rate trending down but still ~3x normal on some paths. Continuing scaling of standby Dedicated nodes.
ops-bot: Autoscaler: added 4 nodes to apn1-standby pool.
pm-lina: Customer impact note: customers X/Y/Z experiencing intermittent failures; drafting initial status message.
support-kim: Draft for status: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency in ap-northeast-1 affecting API calls. Traffic is being routed to other regions to mitigate impact. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes"
oncall-alex: Good. If p95 still > target in 15m, prepare to enable model-fallback to smaller weights for Dedicated pools to reduce load.
sre-jordan: Filing AWS support case: "Regional STS/egress elevated latency causing token-exchange 502/504s, affecting Redwood Hosted+Dedicated in ap-northeast-1." Case opened: #CASE-20260612-001.
eng-ryan: Noting one caveat: some enterprise Dedicated customers pinned to ap-northeast-1 will still see failures; reaching out to account teams.
pm-lina: Noted. Escalating to account owners for those customers.
ops-bot: Health now: frontends 18/24 healthy, 5xx rate down 55% from peak.
sre-jordan: Keeping thread open. If error rate stabilizes for 30m, we'll start controlled rollback of route-set back to normal.
oncall-alex: Thanks all. If AWS responds with root cause, post update here. Otherwise continue monitoring and keep comms cadence.
incident-bot: Note: Incident created INC-2026-0612-APN1, assigned to sre-jordan. Updates expected every 15 minutes.
sre-jordan: Update 00:18 since start: error rate stable but still above baseline; continuing TTL and routing. Preparing postmortem template.
eng-ryan: If anyone needs immediate logs, use: ```/logs query "service:gateway region:ap-northeast-1 status:5xx" --last 15m```
pm-lina: I'll schedule a customer postmortem invite for tomorrow with SRE + product + accounts.
support-kim: Standby: collecting representative request IDs for support tickets.
sre-jordan: Handing to oncall-alex for final watch; I'll remain as primary until AWS reply. Oncall handoff complete at +25s.
oncall-alex: Acknowledged, taking watch. Please ping if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:"
